recommendation.title: Hermes Idea Recommendation Workflow
recommendation.summary: Create a deterministic idea generation, critique, scoring, and recommendation workflow before adding live LLM calls.
rationale: Creates a baseline for later Mastra comparison
risks: May be too deterministic to test real agent behavior

candidates.title: Mastra Runtime Adapter Spike
candidates.summary: Wrap Hermes agents behind a thin runtime adapter so Mastra can be tested without contaminating core logic.
risks: May add abstraction before the runtime is understood

candidates.title: Langfuse Trace Contract
candidates.summary: Define the minimum trace fields Hermes must emit regardless of runtime.
risks: May be premature before workflow behavior exists

review.reason: Recommendation clears threshold, risks are documented, and promotion is approved.

notes: This is the first operational Hermes promotion workflow.
It uses the qualified generate → critique → score → external review → promote path.
Mastra remains qualified for orchestration, but this v1 keeps domain logic plain and artifact-backed.
Langfuse tracing wraps the promotion workflow for observability.
